reproducibility_gaps: No machine-readable dependency manifest or exact resolved environment is supplied, and NumPy, pandas, and SciPy imports are not named in the README dependency list.

The deposited pipe implementation uses TensorFlow, 3x50 subnetworks, trainable-beta Swish, Xavier initialization, Adam learning rate 0.005, and batch 128 rather than the paper-wide PyTorch, 3x20, fixed-Swish, He-normal, 0.001, and batch-50 configuration.
The pipe Python driver specifies 3000 epochs while both notebooks specify 1000; the saved checkpoint notebook also retains an AttributeError from an unspecified incompatible TensorFlow environment.
The aneurysm trainer saves final checkpoints before returning, but main.py then references undefined toc in a post-training timing calculation.
No random seed or deterministic backend configuration is established for collocation shuffling, model initialization, or the pipe Monte Carlo samples.
The paper's stenosis and fixed-geometry viscosity workflows have no dedicated active source entrypoint in the pinned tree, and README marks aneurysm UQ as to be added.
NPZ, PT, PNG, PYC, and ZIP-member payloads remained unopened, so numeric arrays, model tensors, plotted values, and exact source-to-paper run lineage were not independently verified.
The aneurysm training driver opens an interactive plot before training, and no non-interactive/headless workflow is documented.
notes: R3 reflects documented Python/framework requirements and installation, explicit training commands, generated collocation inputs, complete source configurations, bundled arrays, saved checkpoints, archived figures, and comparison helpers.
R4 is withheld because exact paper/source configuration mapping, deterministic seeds, portable evaluation, payload lineage, and conflict-free end-to-end control flow are incomplete.
No scientific workload or binary model/data payload was executed, deserialized, or opened; R5 remains prohibited.
